uzeraan-turmoil.title: Uzeraan's Turmoil
uzeraan-turmoil.intro: Uzeraan: The plague has reached Haven. The crystal portals at the wharf have been corrupted — undead pour through. I need your help.

dark-tides.title: Dark Tides
dark-tides.intro: Mardoth: Death calls to you, fledgling. Walk the dark path — but first, prove your spine.

stages.title: Brew the Blood of the Lich

emino-undertaking.title: Emino's Undertaking
emino-undertaking.intro: Emino: Honor is the spine of every samurai. Walk the path of Bushido — but the elders demand proof.

haochis-trials.title: Haochi's Trials
haochis-trials.intro: Daimyo Tao: The seven ordeals of Haochi await any warrior who would claim the title of true samurai.

stages.title: Trial of Honor — Slay the Oni
Trial of Spirit — Confront the Yamandon

mad-scientist.title: Notes of the Mad Scientist
mad-scientist.intro: Dr. Voltz: My research demands fresh specimens. Bring me what I ask, and I shall reward you. Don't ask why.

witch-apprentice.title: The Witch's Apprentice
witch-apprentice.intro: Old Witch Hilde: My apprentice flees, leaving me alone in the dark. Find them — or bring me the ingredients I need myself.

collector.title: The Collector's Index
collector.intro: Antiquarian Linus: Rare items command rare prices. Bring me what I list, and I shall pay handsomely.

discovering-animal-training.title: Discovering Animal Training
discovering-animal-training.intro: Sandra: Even the wildest beast may be tamed by patience. Begin with the simple — the snake and the dog.

bard-mastery-1-sir-berran.title: Sir Berran's Mastery Test
bard-mastery-1-sir-berran.intro: Sir Berran: A true bard moves the soul. Sing me a song that calms a beast, then return.

bard-mastery-2-felean.title: Felean's Riddle of Sound
bard-mastery-2-felean.intro: Felean: Three songs, three trials. Pass each and the Mastery of Despair shall be yours.

bard-mastery-3-hareus.title: Hareus's Lullaby
bard-mastery-3-hareus.intro: Hareus: The lullaby that pacifies the wildest beast — pass my tests, and it shall be yours.

solen-hive.title: Study of the Solen Hive
solen-hive.intro: Scholar: The Solen tribes wage war beneath our feet. Spy on them — but choose your side carefully.

stages.title: Pick a Side: Red or Black

the-ritual.title: The Ritual
the-ritual.intro: Elder Celcamoine: The corruption spreads through the forest. We must perform the ritual — bring me the components.

the-summoning.title: The Summoning
the-summoning.intro: Elder Treefellow: A great evil sleeps. To wake it, we need power — bring me the items I require.

the-exodus-encounter.title: The Exodus Encounter
the-exodus-encounter.intro: Naturalist: A mechanical horror was once sealed in the depths of Ilshenar. Wake it — and end it.

terrible-hatchlings.title: Terrible Hatchlings
terrible-hatchlings.intro: Merivin: The lizardmen breed terribly fast. Clear out the hatchlings before they're full grown.

cloak-of-humility.title: Cloak of Humility
cloak-of-humility.intro: Wanderer: Walk among the lowly. Without your robe of office, prove your humility — be a vagabond for a day.

stages.title: Visit the Trinsic Shrine of Humility

sacred-quest.title: Sacred Quest of TerMur
sacred-quest.intro: High Mage Apollo: Three trials stand between you and the Throne of the Stygian Dragon — Body, Mind, Spirit.

exploring-the-deep.title: Exploring the Deep
exploring-the-deep.intro: Salty Pete: The deep ocean holds wrecks and worse. Brave the waves with me, and the loot is yours.

tiered-quest-mining.title: Tiered Mining Quest
tiered-quest-mining.intro: Old Joh: Mining grows easier with practice. Bring me ingots — the more, the better.

tiered-quest-lumberjacking.title: Tiered Lumberjacking Quest
tiered-quest-lumberjacking.intro: Joh: Cut me wood, lots of wood.

tiered-quest-alchemy.title: Tiered Alchemy Quest
tiered-quest-alchemy.intro: Mareyna: My shelves need restocking — brew me potions and you will be rewarded.

tiered-quest-blacksmith.title: Tiered Blacksmithing Quest
tiered-quest-blacksmith.intro: Balandar: Steel does not forge itself. Bring me arms and armour.

tiered-quest-carpentry.title: Tiered Carpentry Quest
tiered-quest-carpentry.intro: Aluxer: The shipwrights need lumber-work — saw me planks and bows.

tiered-quest-tailoring.title: Tiered Tailoring Quest
tiered-quest-tailoring.intro: Corso: My clientèle demands fine cloth. Stitch for me.

khaldun-nightmare.title: The Khaldun Nightmare
khaldun-nightmare.intro: Haven Elder: A nightmare stalks the lost city. Investigate the ruins of Khaldun and quiet whatever haunts them.

naturalist-quest.title: The Naturalist's Catalogue
naturalist-quest.intro: Aldur: I am cataloguing the beasts of Britannia. Bring me proof of three apex predators.

bedlam-corruption.title: Bedlam's Whisper
bedlam-corruption.intro: Watcher: Bedlam corrupts. Step into its halls and silence the source.

tomb-of-kings.title: The Tomb of Kings
tomb-of-kings.intro: Archivist: The Tomb of Kings keeps the bones of the old houses. Honor the dead by clearing the wraiths who disturb them.

stages.title: Pay respects at the first sarcophagus

underworld-experimental-room.title: The Experimental Room
underworld-experimental-room.intro: Scholar: Beneath the Stygian Abyss, mages of old experimented on the boundaries of reality. Investigate the chamber, but do not break what you cannot mend.

underworld-maze-of-death.title: The Maze of Death
underworld-maze-of-death.intro: Guide: The Maze of Death has claimed many. Run its corridors and reach the end.

underworld-navreys-lair.title: Navrey's Lair
underworld-navreys-lair.intro: Druid: Navrey, queen of spiders, weaves her web beneath the Abyss. Burn the web before it spreads.

underworld-puzzle-room.title: The Puzzle Room
underworld-puzzle-room.intro: Scholar: Below Navrey lies a chamber of riddles. Solve the puzzle, claim the reward.

stages.title: Activate the four levers in order

tiered-quest-provisioning.title: Tiered Provisioning Quest
tiered-quest-provisioning.intro: Jonath: Bring me supplies — torches, bandages, the basics adventurers need.

heritage-elf.title: Heritage: Path of the Elves
heritage-elf.intro: Syrini: Your spirit has the cadence of our kin. Pass the trials, and the world will name you Elf.

heritage-human.title: Heritage: Reaffirm the Crown
heritage-human.intro: Blackthorne: To stand in Britannia's name is to know its struggles. Walk among the people and prove your loyalty.

heritage-gargoyle.title: Heritage: The Gargish Way
heritage-gargoyle.intro: Zhah: We Gargoyles guard the Abyss. To bear our wings, you must drink from our cup of sorrow and our cup of stone.

knowledge-of-the-soulforge.title: Knowledge of the Soulforge
knowledge-of-the-soulforge.intro: Aurvidlem: Before you wield the soulforge, you must understand its origins. Gather the introductory texts.

mastering-the-soulforge.title: Mastering the Soulforge
mastering-the-soulforge.intro: Aurvidlem: Practice imbuing on prepared materials. Bring me three imbued items of escalating difficulty.

secrets-of-the-soulforge.title: Secrets of the Soulforge
secrets-of-the-soulforge.intro: Aurvidlem: The deepest knowledge is bought in blood. Slay the relic guardians of the Abyss and reforge their essence.

moug-gurr-must-die.title: Moug-Gurr Must Die
moug-gurr-must-die.intro: Irvyn: The ettin chief Moug-Gurr leads raids out of the deep tunnels. Find him and end his rampage.

marauders.title: Marauders
marauders.intro: Irvyn: A band of marauders has overrun the Sanctuary mines. Clear them out before they reach the Royal City.

blighted-grove.title: The Blighted Grove
blighted-grove.intro: Ralan: A poison creeps through the grove. Slay the corrupted before they bloom into something far worse.

ghost-of-covetous.title: The Ghost of Covetous
ghost-of-covetous.intro: Pelos: My brother died in Covetous and his shade wanders the tunnels. Bring me proof of his rest.

honest-beggar.title: The Honest Beggar
honest-beggar.intro: Beggar: I am hungry, kind stranger. Spare what you can — and I shall remember your kindness.

friends-of-the-library.title: Friends of the Library
friends-of-the-library.intro: Librarian: Our collection is incomplete. If you can recover four lost volumes, the city will be grateful.

gemkeepers.title: Gemkeepers
gemkeepers.intro: Mira: We need polished gems to keep up with Royal City demand. Bring me a chest of mixed gems and you'll be paid handsomely.

aemaeth.title: Aemaeth's Charge
aemaeth.intro: Aemaeth: The roots of the World Tree have been corrupted by Mondain's lingering shadow. Cleanse them, and I will teach you a song of binding.

vernix.title: Vernix the Defiler
vernix.intro: Helena: A killer named Vernix struck down my husband. I want him brought to justice — or to the next world, your choice.

ambitious-solen-queen.title: The Ambitious Solen Queen
ambitious-solen-queen.intro: Solen Infiltrator: Our matriarch grows too cautious. Help us elevate a more aggressive queen, and the hive will reward you.

study-of-the-solen-hive.title: Study of the Solen Hive
study-of-the-solen-hive.intro: Tellen: We know little of the solen society. Bring me samples and observation notes — for science.

spellweaving-quest.title: Initiation: Spellweaving
spellweaving-quest.intro: Arielle: Spellweaving is the breath of the trees — to learn it, you must first stand at the Arcane Circle.

ratmen-sanctuary.title: Ratmen Sanctuary
ratmen-sanctuary.intro: Derrick: The ratmen have built a sanctuary in the mountains. Clear it before they organise a war party.

a-tangled-web.title: A Tangled Web
a-tangled-web.intro: Falor: Three witnesses, three stories, one murder. Help me untangle the truth.

a-little-something.title: A Little Something
a-little-something.intro: Uniche: Just need a little something… bring me an apple? I'd be eternally grateful.

discipline.title: Discipline
discipline.intro: Haru: Strength without discipline is folly. Train under me, and prove your patience.

stages.title: Train at the training dummy 10 times

doughty-warriors.title: Doughty Warriors
doughty-warriors.intro: Glannan: Prove your mettle in the arena — three duels, no defeat.

ending-the-threat.title: Ending the Threat
ending-the-threat.intro: Norris: An orc warband has been raiding the Vesper road. Cull them.

gathering-evidence.title: Gathering of Evidence
gathering-evidence.intro: Derric: A thief plagues the courthouse — gather evidence of his crimes before sentencing.

journey-to-athenaeum.title: Journey to the Athenaeum
journey-to-athenaeum.intro: Illvan: The lost Athenaeum holds wisdom from the First Age. Travel its halls and bring me a relic.

bad-company.title: Bad Company
bad-company.intro: Irvyn: Watch out — slith and gargoyle reavers travel in packs. Bring me four pairs of slith ears.

battered-bucket.title: The Battered Bucket
battered-bucket.intro: Tess: My bucket's gone missing. Take this new one to the well-keeper, would you?

honor-of-deboors.title: Honor of the de Boors Quest
honor-of-deboors.intro: de Boors: My family's sword was lost at the battle of Trinsic Pass. Recover it — and our honor.

missing-person.title: Missing Person
missing-person.intro: Walen: A scholar has gone missing in the Lyceum library. Find him — or his remains.

ortlem.title: Ortlem the Hermit
ortlem.intro: Ortlem: An old man's burden is heavy. Spare me a bit of food and I'll share my tale.

pepta.title: Pepta's Plea
pepta.intro: Pepta: A swarm of giant rats has taken my cellar. Will you clear them?

summon-fey-quest.title: Summon Fey
summon-fey-quest.intro: Elenor: Before you may bind a fey, you must convince one to befriend you. Travel to the Fey Glade and prove yourself worthy.

summon-fiend-quest.title: Summon Fiend
summon-fiend-quest.intro: Mardoth: Fiends respect strength. Slay daemons to earn their attention — then bind one to your will.

the-ancient-world.title: The Ancient World
the-ancient-world.intro: Rorvik: I study the world before Britannia. Bring me ancient artifacts — every piece tells a story.

treefellow-wood.title: Treefellow Wood
treefellow-wood.intro: Irwin: The wood spirits cry. Plant five saplings to honor the fallen and the forest will repay you.

unfading-memories.title: Unfading Memories
unfading-memories.intro: Elara: My husband's locket — lost when bandits raided our home. Please return it to me.

unusual-goods.title: Unusual Goods
unusual-goods.intro: Juvarian: I'm a buyer of unusual goods — bring me five 'unusual' items from anywhere and I'll pay handsomely.

pile-of-inspected-valorite.title: Pile of Inspected Valorite Ingots
pile-of-inspected-valorite.intro: Evrard: Bring me valorite ingots already inspected and certified, and I'll forge you something rare.

pile-of-inspected-verite.title: Pile of Inspected Verite Ingots
pile-of-inspected-verite.intro: Evrard: Verite ingots are scarcer than valorite. Bring me 25 and I'll forge you a runic.

bard-mastery-4.title: Bard Mastery — Final Trial
bard-mastery-4.intro: Velinde: You have proven competence with Sir Berran, Felean, and Hareus. Now stand before me, and play the final song.

stages.title: Bring proof of three completed bard mastery chains

valley-of-one.title: Valley of One
valley-of-one.intro: Hawkwind: Time tilts strangely. The mage Anjur opens a path back to Eodon — and the tribes there are at war.

stages.title: Time Is of the Essence — speak with Professor Rafkin
Uniting the Tribes — visit all 9 Eodon settlements

myrmidex-alliance.title: Myrmidex Alliance
myrmidex-alliance.intro: Zipactriotl: Side with the swarm. Crush the tribes that defile our hive.

stages.title: The Zealotry of Zipactriotl — slay 20 tribal warriors
Destruction of Zipactriotl — defeat the Tribal Warlord

eodonian-alliance.title: Eodonian Alliance
eodonian-alliance.intro: Ehecatotl: Help us repel the Myrmidex. The hive must fall before our crops are devoured.

stages.title: Exterminating the Infestation — slay 25 Myrmidex drones
Insecticide and Regicide — defeat the Myrmidex Queen

laifem-the-weaver.title: Laifem the Weaver
laifem-the-weaver.intro: Laifem: Spin me a tale of sheep. I weave, but cloth needs wool — and friendship needs sharing.

stages.title: Weaving Friendships — bring 5 bolts of cloth
New Spin — bring 1 dyed spider silk

paladins-of-trinsic.title: Paladins of Trinsic
paladins-of-trinsic.intro: Sir Dupre: The Brotherhood of Trinsic remembers. Walk the Path of Honor, and we shall enroll you.

stages.title: Paladins of Trinsic II — slay the brigand captain

flint-the-quartermaster.title: Flint the Quartermaster
flint-the-quartermaster.intro: Flint: Thieves emptied my reading. The library at Trinsic has copies — fetch one.

righting-wrong.title: Righting Wrong
righting-wrong.intro: The Royal Britannian Guard needs adventurers at Dungeon Wrong. Inquire at the Court of Truth, thin the prison creatures, defeat Fezzik, then escape with proof of the fallen guard.

stages.title: Inquire at the Court of Truth
Thin out the creatures in Wrong
Find the fallen guard and escape Wrong

righting-wrong-renowned.title: Righting Wrong (Renowned)
righting-wrong-renowned.intro: Darius: The renowned beasts grow bolder. Each must fall — slay one of each, then return.

stages.title: Righting Wrong II — slay a renowned forest creature
Righting Wrong III — slay a renowned mountain creature
Righting Wrong IV — slay a renowned dungeon dweller

professional-bounty.title: Professional Bounty
professional-bounty.intro: Bartlett: The deepwater is plagued with sea creatures. Bring me 10 bounty marks and you'll have your purse.

professional-fisher.title: Professional Fisher
professional-fisher.intro: Quinn: I'm cataloguing the rare fish of the realm. Bring me one of each, and I'll reward you with a master fisher's reel.
